items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: It's like Putin. Like a tag.

ctx.x: No, it wasn't a taxi dance.

Well, what he's talking about, that's just trying to... The thing I was saying about this guy... It's like Putin. Like a tag. When they come to that, and everybody stop, man. And all of a sudden, the drum pick up. Then they start right on back with that number again. I have seen them do that a lot of times, occasionally.
Another thing I noticed when I first heard New Orleans bands is that you don't notice that in other cities and up north is the stomping off business.
